system.description:
[Trigger: Setup] Set 1 Enemy who has the [Nature] tag within 4 Sq from you and has no [Boss] [Raid] tag to [Post-Action]. 1/Scenario

A quilted armor with a powerful stuffed lion's head sewn onto the chest. It has a built-in mechanism that raises both arms straight up to threaten the lion's face and let out a roar just like the real thing. Its roar appeals to the instincts of those who attack it by despising it as a stuffed animal, and has the effect of frightening them, though only for a moment.

Glossy Fur [Core Material] (30G) + Hide Armor (130G) + [Magic Catalyst 2] (20G) x 3 + Crafting Cost (70G)
